content:
Maya R.: quick Q — where do i pull the per-pool autoscale graphs for eu-prod-dedicated? saw a short saturation spike and want to check signals before i open a ticket. pinging here first :slightly_smiling_face:
Sanjay K.: Grafana -> Observability -> Dedicated Pools dashboard. direct link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/pools/eu-dedicated-pools?panelId=4 :eyes:
Sanjay K.: the panel has autoscales, saturation_ratio, queue_depth and token_latency over time. you can change the time window to 30m for transient stuff.
Kevin L.: which signal are you interested in? saturation_ratio or queue_depth spike? we recently added a derived "saturation_ratio" that divides running_tokens by capacity_tokens.
Kevin L.: PromQL snippet if helpful:
```
sum(rate(requests_total{pool="eu-prod-dedicated"}[1m])) by (pool) / avg_over_time(gpu_capacity_tokens{pool="eu-prod-dedicated"}[5m])
```
Kevin L.: that shows load/capacity trend.
Maya R.: looking at token latency + a short backlog hit. graph shows a spike at ~14:12 UTC for ~3m. saturation_ratio went from 0.72 -> 0.95.
Lina C.: Heads up — we tuned the saturation alert last week from 90% -> 93% during canary. ops asked to avoid noisy alerts for short bursts. runbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/alerts/saturation
Lina C.: if this was only ~3m and latency didn't cascade, we might not need a paging incident.
infra-bot: dashboard snapshot created by Maya R. (https://grafana.redwood.internal/snapshot/xyz123)
ops-oncall: for traces, use Jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search and filter service:inference-eu-pool and timeframe 14:10-14:20. add span.tag("pool","eu-prod-dedicated").
Maya R.: thx — will grab a trace and attach logs. posting minimal log excerpt below:
```
2026-02-22T14:12:18Z [pool=eu-prod-dedicated] INFO request_enqueue time_ms=12 queue_len=4 tokens=256
2026-02-22T14:12:26Z [pool=eu-prod-dedicated] WARN queue_drain_latency_ms=3200 avg_token_latency_ms=180
2026-02-22T14:15:01Z [pool=eu-prod-dedicated] INFO scale_up event_id=abc123 new_replicas=2 reason=saturation_ratio
```
Maya R.: filing a short ticket with snapshot + trace + logs, will add a note if it repeats.
Sanjay K.: please include the dashboard panel id and the exact time range. also tag @ops-oncall in the ticket if you want oncall to eyeball.
Maya R.: will do. thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: ack, if it recurs and crosses 93% for >10m we'll escalate per runbook.
Kevin L.: if you want to proactively lower sensitivity for that pool, we can propose a small alert change and test in canary.
Maya R.: filing now — issue #1248 (will update here)"
